findings.title: Deploy step missing `deployment:` environment gate
findings.description: 1 deploy-like step(s) have no `deployment:` field: pull-requests.**[0]. Without it, Bitbucket cannot enforce deployment-scoped variables, approvals, or deployment history.
findings.recommendation: Add `deployment: production` (or `staging` / `test`) to the step. Configure the matching environment in the repo's Deployments settings with required reviewers and secured variables.

findings.title: Step has no `max-time`, unbounded build
findings.description: 1 step(s) have no `max-time` and will run until Bitbucket's 120-minute default kills them: pull-requests.**[0].
findings.recommendation: Add `max-time: <minutes>` to each step, sized to the 95th percentile of historical runtime plus margin. Bounded runs limit the blast radius of a compromised build and prevent runaway minute consumption.

findings.title: Artifacts not signed
findings.description: Pipeline produces build artifacts but does not invoke any signing tool (cosign, sigstore, notation). Unsigned artifacts cannot be verified downstream.
findings.recommendation: Add a step that runs `cosign sign` against the built image or archive, using Bitbucket OIDC for keyless signing where possible. Publish the signature next to the artifact and verify it at deploy time.
